source: Table C-18, p.C-87; Tables C-21 and C-22, pp.C-90 to C-92; C.7.1.2, pp.C-95 to C-96; C.4.8, pp.C-40 to C-41
description: An ARQ request for a peer that is part way through sending expedited data is queued in EXPEDITED-DATA(CONNECTED) and released, in the same transmission as the last EXPEDITED-ACK-ONLY, once the expedited C_PDU is complete.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 9 for ARQ. Link setup as cas/make-called-accept: at 2000 the peer 0.0.1.3 calls with an Ed4 PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST, our accept goes out at 52000, and when that transmission ends at 57550 the link is made with the 16-bit family (B-0213, B-0142) and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 runs (B-0215). D_CONNECTION_MADE starts the expedited ARQ machine afresh as well (C-0755). The peer is recorded Ed4, so spare room in a last block takes a PADDING D_PDU when it fits (C-0367, C-1154). The peer's C_PDU is a DATA C_PDU from SAP 5 to SAP 9 with 'ping' (10 bytes: 00 00 59 40 00 00 70 69 6e 67). At 61000 the peer sends FSN 0 of its expedited C_PDU ID 0, C_PDU START, the first 5 bytes (EOT 20): IDLE(CONNECTED) goes to EXPEDITED-DATA(CONNECTED) (C-0662), the C_PDU is partly received and a type 5 is owed. At 61500 the client sends an S_UNIDATA_REQUEST to SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3 (TTL 0, so TTD 1296061500, 'pong'); the soft link exists, so it goes down as an ARQ C_PDU, and dts.ttd starts. In EXPEDITED-DATA(CONNECTED) the request is queued until the expedited exchange is over (C-0693, C-0737): types 9 and 11 are not among the types that state sends (C-0747, C-1215). At 83000 only the type 5 goes, RX LWE 1 and no bitmap, with a PADDING; the DATA-ONLY (29 bytes) would have fitted in the transmission but is held, since the expedited C_PDU is still partly received (C-1212, C-1215). At 96000 FSN 1 comes with C_PDU END and the last 5 bytes: the C_PDU is delivered (D_EXPEDITED_UNIDATA_INDICATION; cas.first_data stops, C-1216; S_UNIDATA_INDICATION to conn 1). At 151000 the type 5 goes first, RX LWE 2 and no bitmap (12 bytes, EOT 20); placing it ends the expedited exchange and the node goes to DATA(CONNECTED), the queued request being processed as if it had just arrived (C-0737, C-0738, C-1212), so the DATA-ONLY follows in the same transmission: FSN 0, C_PDU START and END, DELIVER IN ORDER, both TX WIN flags, segment size 10 (29 bytes, EOT 20). 41 bytes in 2 blocks; the 9 left take no ACK-ONLY copy and no PADDING. The transmission ends at 161350 and dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts. At 171000 the peer's ACK-ONLY with RX LWE 1 is processed in DATA(CONNECTED) (in IDLE(CONNECTED) it would have drawn WARNING reason 3, C-0659): it acknowledges FSN 0, dts.ack_wait stops, the C_PDU is confirmed and dts.ttd is cancelled. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20 for 1, 2 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so an EXPEDITED-DATA-ONLY is 18 bytes plus its segment, an EXPEDITED-ACK-ONLY 12 bytes plus its bitmap, a MANAGEMENT D_PDU with no extended bytes 13, a WARNING 12, a PADDING 11, a DATA-ONLY 19 bytes plus its segment and a DATA-ACK 22 bytes plus bitmap and segment. dts.ack_wait_ms 60000. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080).  The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived: sis.soft_link_idle and sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only) three answer waits, sis.soft_link_max six; none falls due within the run, and the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326). Since corpus 0.28.0 (P7-3), every D_PDU this node sends to a peer recorded Ed4 carries EOW 0xF01, CAPABILITY (Ed4 1, Duplex 0), where it carried EMPTY (C-0426, C-1260); an owed UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR still goes first (C-1079), and D_PDUs to a peer of unknown edition, a peer recorded Ed3 or a group carry EMPTY as before. Where this note says EOW 0 or EMPTY for such a D_PDU, read CAPABILITY. Only EOW and header CRC bytes changed.
